title: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's £750,000 payment branded possible ‘bribe’ in Turkish woman's passport row
summary_full: A £750,000 payment to Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor has come under scrutiny in a London High Court trial, with lawyers alleging it was linked to help with a Turkish woman's passport or UK residency. The case also involves allegations of financial misconduct against businessman Selman Turk, with Sarah Ferguson and Princess Beatrice mentioned over separate payments.
